SHOT: Straight-on e-commerce packshot, 4:5. ONE ring only, standing upright on the top face, the two hearts at the front facing the camera, the open band behind, on a cream plaster cube. Camera close, a little above the cube's top face, looking down at about thirty degrees. Macro-sharp on the metal.

THE PRODUCT: IMAGE 1 is the supplier photograph and the ONLY authority on what this piece is: copy its construction, its metal colour and its stone colour EXACTLY; it is a shop photo of an open ring on pale satin: take only the ring with the gold heart and the clear stone; ignore the satin and any second ring at the edge. IMAGE 2 is a close detail of the same piece. IMAGE 3 is here ONLY for the plinth, the camera distance, the background and the light: copy its cube and its framing exactly and ignore everything else about it.

CONSTRUCTION LOCK: AN OPEN TOI-ET-MOI RING: a slim plain polished gold band about 1.5mm wide that does NOT close; its two open ends meet side by side at the front and each carries one heart: on one end a PUFFED solid polished gold HEART, smooth and domed, and on the other end ONE clear HEART-shaped faceted stone held in fine gold claws. The two hearts sit side by side, almost touching, facing up. Exactly two hearts: one smooth solid gold puffed heart and one clear faceted heart stone; never two gold hearts, never two stones, never a pearl, never a halo or pave around the stone; the band stays plain and slim.

SCALE TEST: The gold heart is about 7mm across and the clear heart about 6mm, each smaller than a fingernail; the band is about 1.5mm wide. The piece keeps its true small size against the cube, never enlarged.

GROUND: The cream plaster cube fills the lower half of the frame, large and close; flat faces, softly rounded corners, fine plaster grain. Warm cream seamless behind with a gentle gradient falloff, never sand, tan, beige or golden. Soft large key from camera-left, one soft shadow, plus ONE small hard specular kicker from the right, so the metal shows a bright moving highlight and a dark rolled edge on every curve, and every stone shows internal sparkle and a hard white point, never flat colour.

ABSENCE LIST: No hand, no fingers, no model, no fabric, no props, no flowers, no box. No second piece of jewellery. Metal: warm 18k gold tone, never brassy, orange or greenish. No lettering, no watermark, no logo, no tag, no size sticker anywhere in frame. No border, no frame, no paper edge, no vignette: the image fills the whole frame edge to edge.
